escena: SCENE (Run and Gun set, warehouse studio in Miami, night): a single hard backlight behind the crew cuts through a low veil of atmospheric haze, so the beam itself is visible and everyone is rimmed in light; the camera lies on the floor looking steeply up as a gaffer swings a flag into position and a grip tosses a coil of tape upward to a colleague, the coil FROZEN IN MID-AIR against the beam. The crew wear plain dark work t-shirts. Nobody looks at the camera. An orange sandbag sits in the light at the base of a stand. 24mm lens at f/2.8, camera resting on the floor, shutter frozen. Everything is completely unbranded, no brand names, no readable text anywhere.

lecho.objeto: the black equipment case lying on the floor closest to the lens
lecho.tono: DARK near black, matte, with subtle texture
